close_reason: decision captured in code doc comment
description: The doc comment correctly documents that TeletexString gets byte-exact fallback *forever*, not in v0.2. Rationale: RFC 5280 §7.1 marks TeletexString OPTIONAL; no standard T.61→Unicode mapping exists; OpenSSL, NSS, GnuTLS diverge on vendor-specific mappings. Normalizing TeletexString would diverge from peer validators. This decision prevents future contributors from treating byte-exact fallback as a bug to fix. Worth defending and documenting in DECISION.md.
title: DECISION: TeletexString normalization rejected permanently (not deferred)
